missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Удивление' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'было'. The neuter noun ends in -ие in its base form.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Удивление' is the accusative direct object of 'скрыть'. Neuter nouns keep the same form in the accusative as the nominative.

missions.phrase: В его словах не было удивления.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Удивления' takes the genitive after the negated 'не было' to express that none was present. The neuter genitive singular ends in -я.
Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'Удивления' takes the genitive after 'от' to express the cause of the reaction. The neuter genitive singular ends in -я.

missions.phrase: Он смотрел на меня с удивлением.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Удивлением' takes the instrumental after 'с' to describe the manner of looking. The neuter instrumental singular ends in -ем.

missions.phrase: В его удивлении было что-то детское.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Удивлении' takes the prepositional after 'в' to locate the quality within the emotion. The neuter ending -ии marks the prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Удивление' is the accusative direct object of 'вызвало'. 'Общее' agrees in the neuter, describing the shared reaction.
Strategic focus: Dative in fixed phrase. 'Удивлению' takes the dative after 'к' in the set expression meaning to my surprise. The neuter dative singular ends in -ю.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Удивления' is the nominative plural subject of 'были', referring to several reactions. The neuter plural ends in -я, and 'искренними' is the instrumental complement.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Удивления' takes the genitive after 'без' to express the absence of any reaction. The neuter genitive singular ends in -я.
